source.name: 腾讯新闻·九五体育 (Tencent News): 三大行业，成为中超球队胸前广告的赞助商
source.quote: 武汉三镇足球俱乐部的胸前广告是华源证券

summary: 2026 home kit (Nike). Front sponsor Huayuan Securities per Tencent News, March 2026. Back, sleeve and shorts placements could not be verified for 2026 from a source we could open: the club's 2025 announcement of its main-sponsor deal with Wuhan Financial Holdings Group gave subsidiaries Huayuan Securities and Hubei Financial Leasing chest and back advertising rights, but no 2026 source naming the back sponsor was found.
